data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish name Enrique, meaning 'rich, powerful'. This name is popular in Spanish-speaking countries and is considered a feminine variant of the male name Enrique. The name Enriqueta carries the meaning “Rich in power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Enriqueta usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in power and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Enriqueta
in_latin.long_meaning: Enriqueta est nomen femininum quod oritur ex lingua germanica et significat 'Deus est domus mea' vel 'domus Dei'. Nomen derivatur ex nomen hebraicum 'Heinrich', quod significat 'dominus domus' vel 'Deus est domus mea'. Enriqueta adhibetur ut nomen femininum christianum in toto mundo et significat fidelitatem et devotionem ad Deum.
